summary.method: Assistant visual inspection of all 653 current word/phrase raster assets and 23 cast/default-learner portraits on 23 numbered contact sheets, joined to every current runtime use in both language packs. Source-code inspection of interactive practice and personalization. Not a live-site or independent language-expert certification.
limits: Current local checkout, not the deployed site.
All current vocabulary raster mappings and named/default portraits were inspected; decorative branding, selectable avatar variants and unused historic assets are outside the word/phrase audit.
Text tiles and text-only cards are inventoried separately, not counted as illustrations. No picture is not automatically a defect, especially for abstract advanced sentences.
No-obvious-mismatch means no contradiction seen at contact-sheet size; it does not certify that a picture uniquely expresses every grammatical distinction or every personalized variant.
Pending issues are not fixed or approved by writing this report. No artwork was generated or published.

interactive.finding: The writing adventure reuses the weak coffee/tea pair; reading/listening practice has text-only drink choices.
interactive.action: Replace the drink pair first. Add both neutral drink thumbnails to choices equally, without marking which one is correct. Keep target-language text and accessible button names.

interactive.finding: The same host portrait appears at every stage. Before choosing a drink, Your table already shows coffee because the empty choice falls through to coffee. Object buttons are appended only during drink choice, so later bill/payment states have no corresponding object.
interactive.action: Show an empty table before selection, the selected drink after ordering, an empty cup after finishing, then a bill and payment terminal at the relevant stage. Existing menu and portrait are reusable; do not show an order as already delivered before the learner orders.

interactive.finding: The cv1 story describes a crowded café and one free seat. Current conversation renderer shows portraits and dialogue; no seat/counter hotspot implementation or asset reference was found. Both requested images are absent.
interactive.action: Keep free-seat and cafe-counter as planned scene assets. Connect them only when the interactive scene is implemented. The free seat belongs beside Rūta, who has coffee; the waiter in cv1 is Darius, so do not automatically use Danutė as the host in this scene.

interactive.finding: Directions use a labelled 3×3 grid: library west, shop east, park north, learner facing north.
interactive.action: Retain this exact geometry. Existing library/shop/park icons can supplement labels; use a code-rendered north arrow and paths so left/right cannot be reversed by generated artwork. Never add a second map that conflicts with the accessible description.

interactive.finding: Prices, times, family, rooms and shopping sources are mostly rendered as text panels rather than illustrated documents/scenes.
interactive.action: Use code-rendered exact price tags, calendars and clock faces; use matched family diagrams and room layouts where they are the source of information. Put decorative illustrations outside the answer-bearing reading/listening area so an image does not disclose an answer being tested from text or audio.

new_interactive_asset_briefs.brief: One visibly empty wooden café chair pulled out from a small round table; a coffee cup at the neighbouring occupied place, suitable for Rūta's cv1 scene. Transparent background; complete silhouette; no text.
Café counter with till, pastries and a queue of three people seen from behind; unmistakably busy. Transparent background; broad shapes readable at mobile size; no text.
Small café table with an empty place setting and no drink, food or bill; neutral pre-choice state. Transparent background.
The selected café drink's cup after use: visibly empty, on its saucer, without steam. Use separate coffee/tea variants if their vessel silhouettes differ.
Standalone café bill on a small tray. Blank broad receipt lines; exact totals supplied by the app if needed. No person already paying.
Standalone card terminal with an obvious contactless symbol and separate bank card. Neutral waiting state, no success tick before the learner asks to pay.
